ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) pixels comprising approximately 85-90% of the visible ventral area, contrasted by low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels concentrated at the perimeter and central axis.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity perimeter band along the trailing edge; a central vertical low-intensity bifurcation at the median notch; a single high-contrast dark focal spot located in the upper-medial quadrant of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with a wide-angle vertex (~110-120 degrees) and a deep pixel-count recession dividing the two fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) observed continuously along the trailing edge boundary from the median notch to the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave sweep along the trailing edges terminating in acute, slightly tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized three-dimensional tan/brown pixel clusters (consistent with barnacle attachment) at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes; one dark circular rosette on the interior white field of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Active barnacle colonization visible on the trailing edge tips and far-left leading edge.
